object.name: evi_smoothstep
object.description: Fade from zero to one or one to zero with a cubic polynomial shape.

inlets.name: x
inlets.digest: The left edge value. The value of the left edge is the starting value of the fade. The fade transition of the left edge begins when smooth = x, or when the left edge (x) is equal to the value of the signal input (smooth).

inlets.name: y
inlets.digest: The right edge value. The value of the right edge is the end value of the fade transition. The transition of the right edge ends when smooth = y, or when the right edge (y) is equal to the value of the signal input (smooth).

inlets.name: smooth
inlets.digest: The phase input to be smoothed. When the value of the left edge (x) is less that of (y), a fade transition will start with the left edge value being 1 and fall to the right edge value of 0. When the value of the left edge (x) is greater that the right edge (y), a fade transition will start with the right edge value being 0 and rise to the left edge value of 1
